decisive_items: Revealed hyperkeratosis, irregular papillomatosis, parakeratotic columns (cornoid lamella) overlying dyskeratotic keratinocytes, and hypogranulosis with a perivascular infiltration of lymphocytes in the dermis
Scattered, well-defined, annular gray hyperkeratotic plaques with an atrophic center and a slightly elevated edge on the scrotum, buttock, groin, and intergluteal cleft
response.rationale: R3 is champion because its raw support includes the histopathology with cornoid lamella and dyskeratotic keratinocytes, which is the most specific finding. R5 is runner-up because it matches the clinical presentation but lacks the histopathology support. R1, R2, and R4 are rejected because they lack the specific histopathology and their clinical support is less complete.
